unit.why: A Jewish folk legend: a tailor saves the Jews of a Muslim land by bringing the queen a gift and exposing a hostile bishop's false claim of flying to Muhammad's tomb. It has no Hasidic figures.

stories.start_quote: מעשה מהחייט ומדי דברי במשטמת הישמעאלים
stories.end_quote: ונתקנו כל צנורות השפע עוד יוחד מלפנים
stories.summary_en: When a bishop's incitement brings persecution on the Jews of a Muslim land, a tailor volunteers to bring the queen one of a pair of precious earrings. He tells her the other must be fetched from Muhammad's tomb, which the bishop claims to fly to yearly; this exposes the bishop's fraud, and the bishop repents and publicly reverses his preaching against the Jews.

tags.why: The whole plot is Jews against Muslims and the bishop.
